run_export_beam_pipeline: run the Apache Beam pipeline to export Earth Engine data to a TensorFlow Dataset using a config file
create_tfds_builder: create a TFDSBuilder instance with a config, dataset name, output directory, and list of splits
create_beam_dofn_createdata: create a CreateData DoFn that filters Earth Engine label items by train, validation, or test split
build_tfds_features_dict: build a TensorFlow Dataset features dictionary from a config by processing a single sample item
get_metadata_keys: get the list of metadata keys to export from source configs including timestamps and additional properties
